card.name: Dosing frequency words mid-instruction
card.fires_on: Frequency or schedule words (daily, every, other, weekly, for) inside dosing instructions about changing, resuming or returning to a schedule.

card.writes: Promotes words meaning 'no longer' and 'increasingly', suggesting a shift of state or change over time.
card.plain: It lights up on schedule words like daily or every other when a dosing plan is being changed or resumed.
